notes.title: Content update
notes.notes:
So a truck with content turned over on our street.

We present to you our big update in which we have included:
1) Added 4 more maps with two modes (night and day).
2) Added a lot of new clothes for skiers.
3) Significantly redesigned skier gameplay. We have been calibrating and improving skiing for a long time.
4) Added 2 arcade elements.

I hope you will like it! Enjoy skiing!

notes.title: PATCH BUGS
notes.notes:
Dear gamers: Thank you for reporting bugs that were hiding in the snowdrifts. We keep fighting them.ːsteamthumbsupː

Today’s patch fixes an issue with exiting level after the match, floating through terrain on the night maps and hanging in the air on start. Our snowstorm team(the coders) successfully defeated these bugs. 

We still have some work to do. Some players could not play the game on SteamVR controllers; we are developing the best solution. Also, we are almost at the finish line of dividing single and multiplayer modes and implementing the free ride mode.

notes.title: Hey guys! Catch a major new update for our demo!
notes.notes:
ːsteamthisːWe took into account the wishes of our fans and released a major update for our demo. Now our demo version works correctly on most VR devices.ːsteamthisː

Detailed list of changes:
1. Added fans.
2. Optimization of visual effects.
3. Added forest detailing.
4. Improved track shape.
5. Added support for most VR devices.

Check out our new control system!ːsteamsaltyː
